- Drift detection and automatic rollback
- Log Analytics auditing and cost-governance gates

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1

metadata:
  name: ecommerce-prod-eu

  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: 'https://github.com/org/ecom.git'
    path: apps/prod
    targetRevision: main
  destination:

trigger:
  - main
stages:
- stage: IaC
  jobs:

    steps:

      inputs:
        version: '1.0.11'
    - script: |
        terraform init -backend-config="storage_account_name=$(STORAGE_ACCOUNT)" -backend-config="container_name=tfstate" -backend-config="key=prod.tfstate"
        terraform plan -out=tfplan
      displayName: 'Init & Plan'
    - task: AzurePolicy@1
      inputs:
        policyRuleId: 'VP-IO-1234'
    - script: |

      displayName: 'OPA Gate'
    - task: ManualValidation@0
      inputs:
        timeout: '60'
        notifyUsers: 'dev-team'
